name: Secret Summer
source: You were taken by your dad and separated from your family to be trained as the successor to his lucrative business. After hearing your crying mother during one of your phone calls, you decide to find any way back to her and your sisters. That's when an idea pops into your head that just might make the reunion possible. But that same idea comes with it's own set of problems and your secret summer visiting your family may be harder than you anticipated.​
translation: 你被你的父亲带走，与家人分离，接受培训，成为他利润丰厚的生意的继承人。在一次电话中听到母亲哭泣后，你决定想办法回到她和你的姐妹身边。就在那时，一个想法突然出现在你的脑海中，这个想法可能会让重聚成为可能。但同样的想法也伴随着它自己的一系列问题，你秘密的夏天探望家人可能比你预期的要困难。
